answer_1.quote: In this work we propose a novel approach, QAaP (Question Answering as Programming), to tackle the challenges posed by time-sensitive factual questions.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are answers to time-sensitive factual questions, generated through a process of parsing questions and context into code, extracting relevant information, and selecting the best-matching answer using programming-based verification.

answer_2.quote: Table  presents the main results on the three temporal reasoning datasets. QAaP consistently demonstrates superior performance across all the datasets under a few-shot setting.
